common.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

language.title: Parakh
language.prompt: Choose your language · اپنی زبان منتخب کریں

privacy.title: Why we need your number and your voice
privacy.numberRequired: Parakh needs your mobile number to create your account and keep your reports linked to you.
privacy.notAnonymous: Reporting on Parakh is not anonymous. Each report is linked to your account.
privacy.numberForSignIn: Your number is used to sign you in with a one-time code sent by SMS.
privacy.staffNeverSee: Officials, representatives and contractors never receive your number.
privacy.voiceStored: When you describe an issue by voice, the original recording is stored.
privacy.aiErrors: A computer system (AI) turns your recording into Urdu text. That text may contain mistakes.
privacy.aiProvider: The AI service that will process recordings has not been chosen yet. This notice will be updated before release.
privacy.reviewBeforeSend: You read and correct the Urdu text before your report is sent.
privacy.smsOptional: SMS updates about your reports are optional, and you choose them separately.
privacy.withdraw: You can turn optional choices off later without losing your account.

consent.title: Your choices
consent.intro: Each choice is separate. The first two are needed to create an account.
consent.account: I agree that Parakh creates my account and processes my information to handle my reports.
consent.voice: I agree that Parakh stores my voice recordings and processes them with AI.
consent.sms: Send me SMS updates about my reports.
consent.requiredMissing: Both required choices are needed to continue. You can still go back.

phone.title: Your mobile number
phone.reminder: We send a one-time code to this number. It is the only identifier Parakh asks for.
phone.label: Mobile number
phone.invalid: Please enter a valid Pakistani mobile number, for example 300 1234567.
phone.offline: You need an internet connection to sign in.
phone.wait: Please wait {{seconds}} seconds before asking for another code.
phone.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please try again later.
phone.consentChanged: The consent text has changed. Please review your choices again.
phone.devTestNumberOnly: This development build accepts only the designated test numbers, such as 300 1234567. Please do not use a real number.

otp.title: Enter the code
otp.sentTo: We sent a six-digit code to {{number}}.
otp.label: Six-digit code
otp.wrong: The code is wrong or has expired.
otp.noAttempts: Please ask for a new code.
otp.resendIn: You can ask for a new code in {{seconds}} seconds.
otp.offline: You need an internet connection to verify this code.
otp.consentRequired: Please review and accept the consent to create an account.
otp.unavailable: This account cannot sign in. Please contact support.

home.title: Home
home.notYet: Not available in this build yet

evidence.title: Show the issue
evidence.intro: Take 1 to 3 live photos of the issue. You can also record one video of up to 60 seconds.
evidence.photoLimit: You already have 3 photos. Delete one to take another.
evidence.videoLimit: You already have a video. Delete it to record another.
evidence.videoTooLong: This video is longer than 60 seconds, so it was not kept. Please record a shorter one.
evidence.unreadable: This video could not be read, so it was not kept. Please record it again.
evidence.tooLarge: This item is too large to send, so it was not kept. Please try again.
evidence.storageFull: Your phone is almost out of storage, so nothing was recorded. Your draft and earlier items are kept. Free some space and try again.
evidence.saveFailed: This item could not be saved. Your draft and earlier items are kept. Please try again.
evidence.draftGone: This draft is no longer on this phone. Drafts are kept for 2 days.
evidence.notEditable: This report has already been sent, so its photos and video cannot change.
evidence.cameraWhy: Parakh needs the camera to take live photos of the issue. Pictures from your gallery cannot be used.
evidence.cameraDenied: Without the camera, Parakh cannot take the photo every report needs. Your draft is kept on this phone. To continue, allow the camera in Settings.
evidence.micWhy: A video also records sound, so it needs the microphone.
evidence.micDenied: Without the microphone, Parakh cannot record a video. You can still take photos.
evidence.needPhoto: Take at least one photo to continue.
evidence.cameraUnavailable: The camera could not start. Close Parakh and open it again.
evidence.needConnection: Connect to the internet once to finish signing in on this phone, then try again.
evidence.storeFailed: Your drafts could not be opened. Close Parakh and open it again.

session.expired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
